name: fb-lane-coordination
description: Flow Builder helps product managers turn deep workstream conversations into a coordinated, explained delivery plan in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Explore product questions deeply across User, Business, Design, Tech, Discovery and Bugs workstreams. Product/BFM (Build For Me) brings their handoffs together into one explained plan: priorities, dependencies, blockers, deferrals and stakeholder trade-offs. Preview what will happen before implementation. Codex executes the work; Flow Builder supplies repository-local coordination, evidence and release boundaries. Requires Codex with local filesystem, Git and Node.js access. Sidebar automation depends on available Codex task controls and otherwise provides a manual fallback. No FB-hosted service or required MCP server. Existing chats and project work are preserved by the upgrade workflow. This beta does not guarantee conflict-free execution, time savings or token savings.
defaultPrompt: Set up Flow Builder in this project while preserving existing work and chats.
Preview the queued handoffs, priorities, dependencies and blockers.
Use $bfm in Product/BFM to plan and execute the ready handoffs.

On an explicit user $bfm or /bfm invocation in Product/BFM, show the prioritized queue and proceed through routine authorized work without a second okay. Apply the shared autonomy policy: up to five distinct evidence-backed recovery attempts per issue, preserved across slices and resumes. Passive handoff pings never invoke BFM. Full Access is capability, not scope or release approval. Preserve safety and Push Live. End progress and final messages with TLDR and Recommendation.
